Definition: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
BiblicalUsage: adj; 1) great; 1a) large (in magnitude and extent); 1b) in number; 1c) in intensity; 1d) loud (in sound); 1e) older (in age); 1f) in importance; 1f1) important things; 1f2) great, distinguished (of men); 1f3) God Himself (of God); subst; 1g) great things; 1h) haughty things; 1i) greatness; n pr m; 1j) (CLBL) Haggedolim, the great man?, father of Zabdiel
